source_semantics.visibility: The source governance submit surface is meaningful only while a structured AI suggestion exists and disables the submit action while an approval submission is in progress.
source_semantics.defaults: Blank operation type becomes AI.ContentUpdate, blank approval title becomes AI content proposal, and risk defaults to High.
source_semantics.proposal: The source submits an approval containing optional selected site identity/name, exact before content, exact proposed after content, prompt key, model, affected fields, explanation, confidence, authenticated actor label, risk level, and a unique request key.
source_semantics.result: After the approval service returns, the source stores the new approval ID/status and reports Structured proposal submitted to the approval queue.
source_semantics.scanner_note: The generated visible-control row carries mutation=false as scanner metadata, but the authoritative source handler performs a real governance persistence transition. This adaptation follows the source handler rather than treating the coarse scanner flag as permission to implement a fake/no-op control.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: backend/resources/js/ai-center-approval-status-control.tsx renders AIMW-AI-93EBFDE5A1 only for a structured suggestion, exposes source-equivalent risk/operation/title/before-after governance controls, disables while submitting, and reports success only after the server confirms persisted creation.
laravel_adaptation.endpoint: POST /api/tenants/{tenant}/ai-center/approvals is explicitly registered under web + auth + tenant.context and authorizes ai.use in AiCenterApprovalSubmissionController.
laravel_adaptation.persistence: A direct AI approval is persisted in the existing tenant-scoped approvals table with nullable legacy suggestion_id plus source_operation_id, optional site snapshot, operation type, title, actor label, risk, request key, structured before_state, structured proposed_state, actor_user_id, and PENDING status.
laravel_adaptation.legacy_compatibility: Existing SEO suggestion approvals retain suggestion_id semantics. The migration is fresh/rollback/forward tested and its down path refuses destructive rollback while direct AI approvals exist.
laravel_adaptation.actor_boundary: actor_user_id and actor_label come only from the authenticated server-side user; the browser cannot submit an arbitrary actor.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_boundary: Optional site_id resolves through the active TenantContext global scope. A foreign site ID fails 404, and a member of Alpha cannot submit into Beta.
laravel_adaptation.idempotency: A browser-generated UUID request_key is unique per tenant. Repeating the same request key returns the existing approval rather than creating a duplicate; the database unique constraint closes the concurrent race.
laravel_adaptation.truthful_failure: Validation/authorization/server rejection renders failure and never reports submission success or fabricates a PENDING approval.
laravel_adaptation.execution_boundary: Direct generic AI approvals cannot enter the SEO suggestion executor. ExecutionCreator fails closed with 409 when suggestion_id is null, preserving existing SEO execution semantics until a domain-specific AI executor is separately implemented and claimed.
laravel_adaptation.queue_read: The existing approval queue read contract now returns direct-AI metadata while preserving legacy fields and execution linkage.

tenant_and_security.caller_tenant_override: No tenant field is accepted in the request body; frontend endpoint is derived solely from encoded FrontendContext.tenant.slug.
tenant_and_security.secret_surface: No provider credential, WordPress credential, token, or secret is accepted or returned.
tenant_and_security.external_runtime: Submitting the governance proposal requires no live provider or WordPress mutation. No provider/WordPress/production evidence is manufactured by this operation.
